purpose: The identity the reviewer must independently verify. Do not trust this file: it tells you which digests the project claims, and how to recompute them from the bytes in your hands. Your submission records the digest YOU computed.

independentVerification.iso: sha256sum <the .iso you were given> and compare against isoSha256
independentVerification.qcow2: sha256sum <the .qcow2 you were given> and compare against qcow2Sha256
independentVerification.ociTar: sha256sum <the OCI archive .tar you were given> and compare against ociTarSha256
independentVerification.raw: sha256sum <the .raw disk you were given> and compare against rawSha256
independentVerification.image: skopeo inspect --format '{{.Digest}}' oci-archive:<the OCI archive> (or podman inspect after a digest-pinned load) and compare against imageDigest
independentVerification.onMismatch: STOP. Record the digest you computed, submit MORE_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED or refuse, and say which bytes you were given. A review of other bytes satisfies nothing for this artifact (blocking condition 6).

consistency: This file must agree with qualification/phase9/intake/LEDGER.json subjectArtifact; tests/release/test_phase11_security_review.py asserts it, so a drift between the commissioning package and the intake boundary fails the suite.
signingNote: UNSIGNED is a fact about the artifact, not a waiver: blocking condition 7 stays true independently of this review.
